MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 23

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 22
   C. 38
   D. 19

4. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 25

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
